inventory_execution: Compiled binary --list --format terse, after the single full test; metadata only
target_release: Root explicitly released MAIN exclusively after the Queue claim; no other Cargo or source mutations during this control
hash_scope: Every Git-tracked lampOS file, including docs, Rust/Cargo/toolchain/config and fixture inputs; every prepared file verified against the committed blob. Excludes ignored/untracked files and paths outside lampOS.
freshness: Refresh mtimes of every file in that exact tracked scope; compare all bytes before/after refresh and after execution
cleanup: Each command owns a new process session. Inspect only that session, including child process groups, and terminate leftovers with bounded TERM/KILL. Never signal unrelated sessions.
causal_limit: Current-head control on changed upstream, NOT a matched causal pair with EC/735. A pass does not clear or waive the failed candidate. No mutations, stress or retry.
